Us

Our story is His grace.

“He has made everything beautiful in its time.” — Ecclesiastes 3:11

We are two imperfect people with stories of our own, yet God, in His grace, has shown us that He is able to redeem, restore, and make all things beautiful in His time. What He has brought together is not simply a story of two people finding each other, but a testimony of His faithfulness and sovereignty—proof that He is always at work, even in seasons we do not understand. As we begin this new chapter, our prayer is that our love and marriage would point beyond us to Christ, the true Author of our story, and that through it all, He alone would be glorified.
